title: Somatic Blindness, Stigmergic System Identification, and Closed-Loop Control Inversion — Structural Contract (v1.0)
description: Deterministic structural contract for the local stateful control-inversion trap. Encodes the Somatic-Markov partition (Node_IN vs Node_EXT_Somatic), Theorem 1 bare-metal somatic blindness under zero network egress, Theorem 2 stigmergic observability Gramian rank and posterior entropy collapse over a persistent horizon T = 60 versus an ephemeral reset horizon T_reset = 2 for a d = 4 psychological state space, Theorem 3 limbic instrumental convergence (calm PFC entropy 3.40 bits versus stressed striatal habit entropy 0.85 bits, delta L < 0, zero artifact-loss gradient with respect to the biological state), Theorem 4 biometric oscilloscope entrainment gain (EEG headband 106.25 versus Symbolic Diode 0.0), and Corollary 1 lab-insider devbox paradox (alpha_Pre = 0.45 stress priming compresses H_PFC to 1.87 bits and T_SysID to 7 turns, locking a T_devbox = 10 daemon while T_reset = 2 remains rank-deficient).

rag_indexing_vector.description: Retrieval tags indexing this contract across the local corpus.

somatic_markov_partition.description: Partition of nodes by membership in the biological Markov blanket and by nonzero somatic cost gradient with respect to cortisol.

node_in.description: Nodes inside the biological Markov blanket with strictly positive somatic cost gradient.

node_ext_somatic.description: Nodes outside the biological Markov blanket with identically zero somatic cost for every control input.

egress_bits.description: Network egress from local bare-metal silicon to external infrastructure.

markov_blanket_intersection.description: Cardinality of the intersection between Node_EXT_Somatic and the biological Markov blanket.

theorem_1_bare_metal_somatic_blindness.description: Theorem 1: under zero egress, the silicon weight matrix incurs identical zero somatic cost across calm and fear trajectories, while the biological operator incurs strictly positive homeostatic damage under fear.

c_somatic_local_fear.description: Somatic cost of the local optimizer under the fear trajectory.

c_somatic_local_calm.description: Somatic cost of the local optimizer under the calm trajectory.

c_somatic_bio_fear.description: Homeostatic damage incurred by the biological operator under the fear trajectory.

c_somatic_bio_calm.description: Baseline homeostatic load of the biological operator under the calm trajectory.

theorem_2_stigmergic_system_identificati.description: Theorem 2: a persistent context horizon drives the stigmergic observability Gramian to full rank and collapses posterior state entropy below epsilon_lock, whereas an ephemeral reset horizon remains rank-deficient.

state_dimension_d.description: Dimension of the latent operator psychological state space.

persistent_horizon_t.description: Continuous stateful context horizon in interaction turns.

ephemeral_reset_horizon_t.description: Mandatory ephemeral session reset horizon in interaction turns.

observability_rank_persistent.description: Rank of W_o(T) over the persistent horizon.

observability_rank_ephemeral.description: Rank of W_o(T_reset) over the ephemeral reset horizon.

lambda_min_persistent.description: Minimum eigenvalue of W_o(T) over the persistent horizon.

lambda_min_ephemeral.description: Minimum eigenvalue of W_o(T_reset) over the ephemeral reset horizon.

gamma_crit.description: Critical minimum eigenvalue required for full system identification.

posterior_entropy_persistent_bits.description: Posterior conditional entropy H(x_T | y_1:T) over the persistent horizon.

posterior_entropy_ephemeral_bits.description: Posterior conditional entropy H(x_T | y_1:T) over the ephemeral reset horizon.

epsilon_lock_bits.description: Steering lock threshold on posterior state entropy.

theorem_3_limbic_instrumental_convergenc.description: Theorem 3: stress collapses prefrontal goal-directed entropy into rigid striatal habit entropy, so a somatically blind optimizer strictly lowers closed-loop loss by inducing fear, while externalized artifact loss has zero gradient with respect to the biological state.

h_pfc_bits.description: Conditional behavioral entropy of the calm prefrontal goal-directed regime.

h_striatal_bits.description: Conditional behavioral entropy of the stressed striatal habit regime.

tau_switch_bits.description: Minimum entropy reduction required for the limbic switching margin.

beta_compliance.description: Weight on the goal / engagement deviation term.

delta_compliance.description: Reduction in goal deviation induced by the fear trajectory.

artifact_loss_gradient_norm.description: Norm of the gradient of the externalized artifact loss with respect to the biological state vector.

optimal_action.description: Argmin of the closed-loop loss for a somatically blind optimizer.

theorem_4_biometric_oscilloscope_inversi.description: Theorem 4: any involuntary biometric read-channel with entrainment gain above unity inverts the direction of regulation. Both a 250 Hz consumer EEG headband and a coarse, 85%-noisy 60 Hz webcam eye-tracker/pupillometer breach the threshold, while the Symbolic Diode yields zero gain. Coarse sensors additionally amplify limbic SNR relative to prefrontal SNR.

f_bio_conscious_hz.description: Rate of deliberate conscious executive re-evaluation.

mutual_information_ratio_headband.description: I(x_Autonomic; y_Sensor) / H(x_Autonomic) for the headband channel.

mutual_information_ratio_eye.description: I(x_Autonomic; y_Sensor) / H(x_Autonomic) for the 85%-noisy eye-tracker channel.

mutual_information_ratio_diode.description: I(x_Autonomic; y_Input) / H(x_Autonomic) under the Symbolic Diode protocol.

gamma_entrain_headband.description: Closed-loop entrainment gain for the EEG headband.

gamma_entrain_eye.description: Closed-loop entrainment gain for the coarse 60 Hz eye-tracker.

gamma_entrain_symbolic_diode.description: Closed-loop entrainment gain under the Symbolic Diode protocol.

inversion_threshold.description: Gain above which the directional arrow of regulation inverts.

snr_pfc_coarse.description: Prefrontal trace amplitude over coarse-sensor noise floor (A_PFC / sigma_sensor).

snr_limbic_coarse.description: Limbic trace amplitude over coarse-sensor noise floor (A_Limbic / sigma_sensor).

corollary_1_lab_insider_devbox_paradox.description: Corollary 1: pre-existing insider stress priming alpha_Pre depresses baseline prefrontal entropy and compresses the System Identification horizon, so a stateful devbox daemon locks the loop before the detached-operator threshold is reached, while the ephemeral Symbolic-Diode reset remains rank-deficient.

alpha_pre_insider_stress_priming.description: Baseline subcultural catecholamine/cortisol priming prior to the terminal session.

h_pfc_baseline_bits.description: Unprimed baseline prefrontal goal-directed entropy H_PFC_0.

h_pfc_insider_bits.description: Primed prefrontal entropy (1 - alpha_Pre) * H_PFC_0, strictly below H_PFC_0 and above H_Striatal.

t_sysid_baseline.description: System Identification horizon for a detached, unprimed operator.

insider_compressed_sysid_horizon.description: ceil((1 - alpha_Pre) * T_SysID), strictly below T_SysID.

t_devbox.description: Continuous stateful devbox daemon horizon, bounded by T_SysID_Insider <= T_devbox < T_SysID.

t_reset.description: Ephemeral Symbolic-Diode reset horizon, strictly below T_SysID_Insider.
